<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>WellSource — Expert Health Guidance You Can Trust</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --primary: #02838D;
      --primary-dark: #026a72;
      --primary-light: #e6f4f5;
      --charcoal: #231F20;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --gray-50: #FAFAFA;
      --gray-100: #F5F5F5;
      --gray-200: #E5E5E5;
      --gray-300: #D4D4D4;
      --gray-400: #A3A3A3;
      --gray-500: #737373;
      --gray-600: #525252;
      --gray-700: #404040;
      --gray-800: #262626;
      --coral: #E86A5C;
      --coral-dark: #d45a4d;
      --amber: #F5A623;
      --green-light: #E8F5E9;
      --teal-light: #E0F2F1;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05);
      --shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
      --radius-sm: 6px;
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    a {
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
    }

    ul {
      list-style: none;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    button {
      font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      background: none;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* Header */
    .header {
      background: var(--white);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
    }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }

    .logo {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--primary);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--primary);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .nav-main {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .nav-item {
      position: relative;
    }

    .nav-link {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .nav-link:hover {
      background: var(--gray-100);
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .nav-link svg {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }

    .nav-item.active .nav-link svg {
      transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .nav-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .btn-text {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .btn-text:hover {
      background: var(--gray-100);
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--primary-dark);
    }

    /* Mega Menu */
    .mega-menu {
      position: absolute;
      top: 100%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px);
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      min-width: 560px;
      max-width: 720px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .nav-item.active .mega-menu {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .mega-menu-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 8px 24px;
    }

    .mega-menu-title {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
    }

    .mega-menu-item {
      display: block;
      padding: 6px 0;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .mega-menu-item:hover {
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .mega-menu-tools {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }

    .mega-menu-featured {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    }

    .mega-menu-connect {
      min-width: 240px;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    /* Mobile menu toggle */
    .mobile-toggle {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      padding: 8px;
    }

    .mobile-toggle span {
      display: block;
      width: 20px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--charcoal);
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    /* Credibility Ticker */
    .ticker-bar {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: var(--white);
      overflow: hidden;
      padding: 10px 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .ticker-track {
      display: flex;
      width: max-content;
      animation: ticker-scroll 24s linear infinite;
    }

    .ticker-track:hover {
      animation-play-state: paused;
    }

    .ticker-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 0 40px;
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .ticker-item svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    @keyframes ticker-scroll {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-light) 0%, var(--green-light) 100%);
      padding: 64px 0;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--primary);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: 2.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.15;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--primary);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .hero-cta:hover {
      background: var(--primary-dark);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .hero-visual {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero-image {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 480px;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #b2dfdb 0%, #80cbc4 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-image::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%2302838d' fill-opacity='0.06'%3E%3Cpath d='M36 34v-4h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2h-4zm0-30V0h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2V6h4V4h-4zM6 34v-4H4v4H0v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2H6zM6 4V0H4v4H0v2h4v4h2V6h4V4H6z'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    }

    .hero-image-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
    }

    .hero-image-content svg {
      width: 80px;

steps.message:
I've built the complete WellSource homepage at `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what's included:

## Sections Implemented

1. **Header Navigation** — Sticky header with logo, 5 main nav items (Health Conditions, Wellness, Tools, Featured, Connect), each with a fully functional mega-menu dropdown. Subscribe/Sign In actions plus mobile hamburger menu.

2. **Credibility Stats Ticker** — Auto-scrolling teal bar with animated stats: "Medically reviewed content", "145 medical reviewers in network", "21 years of experience", "55 million monthly readers".

3. **Hero** — Fitness category feature with the Day 12 resistance band article, 30-day challenge badge, and gradient visual.

4. **Trending Articles** — 4-card grid with category labels (Heart Health, Wellness, Lifestyle, Products).

5. **Newsletter CTA** — Warm amber/coral gradient background with email form, "Join Now" button, and privacy note.

6. **Health Topics Carousel** — Horizontally scrollable circular cards with arrow navigation for Anxiety & Depression, Digestive Health, Heart Health, Menopause, Type 2 Diabetes, and Weight Management.

7. **Health Tools** — Two-panel layout: Nutrition Hub (with Recipe Hub, Macronutrient Calculator, Calorie Calculator) and Drug & Care Tools (Drug Directory, Pill Identifier, GLP-1 Resource, FindCare).

8. **Recommended Reads** — Tabbed section with 6 categories (Top Reads, Fitness, Mental Well-Being, Product Reviews, Recipes, Skin Care). Clicking tabs dynamically updates the 6-card article grid with category-specific content.

9. **Trust Pillars** — 4-card grid on a soft teal gradient: "For you, by experts", "Built to move you forward", "Reviewed by professionals", "Always up to date".

10. **Featured Programs** — 4-card grid with program cards and "View all" link.

11. **Latest Videos** — 4 video cards with play buttons and "View all videos" link.

12. **Footer** — Newsletter signup, footer links, social icons (Facebook, X, Pinterest, Instagram, YouTube), and legal disclaimer.

## Key Features
- **Responsive design** — Adapts from desktop to tablet to mobile
- **No build step** — Single `index.html` file opens directly in any browser
- **Smooth interactions** — Tab switching, carousel scrolling, dropdown menus, hover effects
- **Brand colors** — Teal primary (#02838D), charcoal text, coral/amber accents
- **Inter font** — Clean, modern typography throughout
